visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A variety of burger dishes and side orders are laid out on a table, including a brisket burger topped with purple pickled onions and a tall glass of purple berry soda. (2) Close-up on a chef wearing black gloves as they slice into a large, dark-crusted piece of roasted meat on a wooden board; the interior of the meat is pink and juicy. (3) The chef continues to slice thin pieces of brisket, then uses a culinary torch to sear the meat slices in a metal bowl. (4) A burger bun is sliced in half and placed on a flat grill, being toasted until the edges are slightly browned. (5) The burger is assembled layer by layer: a toasted bottom bun, fresh green lettuce, several slices of seared brisket, and a drizzle of dark BBQ sauce. (6) A piece of golden-brown fried oyster mushroom is dipped into a small container of white cream sauce. (7) A chicken burger is shown, featuring a thick fried chicken thigh topped with white sauce and pickled onions. (8) Clear bubbly water is poured into a glass containing purple berry syrup at the bottom, creating a gradient drink. (9) Wide shots of the restaurant interior show light wood furniture, yellow chairs, and a minimalist, clean aesthetic with a small dog mascot visible. (10) The exterior of the shop is white with 'WE-DO BURGER' printed on the wall, and several scooters are parked out front.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 發現一家. [Logo]: @hooleefun. (2) [Subtitle]: 好吃的漢堡店. (3) [Subtitle]: 是用整塊原肉料理. (4) [Subtitle]: 不是肉排. (5) [Subtitle]: 老闆特製爐烤的牛胸肉很多汁. (6) [Subtitle]: 每一份肉都是現點現切. (7) [Subtitle]: 再炙燒. (8) [Subtitle]: 漢堡的麵包會抹奶油. (9) [Subtitle]: 煎烤到表面微酥. (10) [Subtitle]: 加上生菜. (11) [Subtitle]: 烤牛胸肉 BBQ醬. (12) [Subtitle]: 吃起來軟嫩富含油脂香氣. (13) [Subtitle]: 還有搭配紅酒醋漬洋蔥. (14) [Subtitle]: 墨西哥辣椒增添口感. (15) [Subtitle]: 附餐薯條可以升級換成現炸杏鮑菇. (16) [Subtitle]: 不吃牛推薦蒜香酸奶炸雞堡. (17) [Subtitle]: 厚實的無骨雞腿肉. (18) [Subtitle]: 稍微醃製帶點鹹甜鮮香. (19) [Subtitle]: 濃郁蒜味 飽滿又刷嘴. (20) [Subtitle]: 升級咖哩肉醬薯條更過癮. (21) [Subtitle]: 會附一杯指定飲料. (22) [Subtitle]: 可以換購莓果果醬氣泡飲. (23) [Subtitle]: 想吃漢堡就約這裡. [Slogan]: 溫度漢堡 WeDo Burger 高雄市三民區錦州街170號. (24) [Subtitle]: 也能帶毛小孩來用餐哦. (25) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. (26) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉.

(2) A sharp, crisp slicing sound occurs as a knife cuts through meat, accompanied by a subtle sizzle. (3) The rhythmic sound of a butane torch's hiss is heard, indicating the searing of food. (4) Soft shuffling sounds of buns being moved on a grill. (5) Bubbling and pouring sounds are clearly audible as a drink is being made. (6) Throughout, the narrator maintains a consistent, enthusiastic pace, describing the food items while the bright guitar BGM continues uninterrupted until the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Ingredient Preparation -> Assembly Process -> Product Tasting -> Variety/Options -> Store Information
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional food review for 'WeDo Burger' in Kaohsiung. It emphasizes the quality of ingredients, specifically highlighting the use of whole smoked brisket rather than processed patties. By showing the detailed preparation and assembly of their signature burgers and side dishes, the video aims to entice viewers to visit the restaurant.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names the restaurant, provides its address, showcases the menu in detail, and uses a professional narration style typical of food influencers (Hooleefun).

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-saturation visuals and fast-paced editing to create an appetizing and lively atmosphere, common in social media food marketing.
